blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. on Wednesday called the first tunnel boring machine (TBM) breakthrough of the Metro Manila Subway Project (MMSP) at Quezon Avenue station an important milestone in the construction of the country’s first-ever underground railway system. Marcos inspected the site of the Quezon Avenue station, where excavation has been completed up to the southbound portion of North Avenue station — a distance of about 1.1 kilometers (km) and 34 meters below ground. A breakthrough refers to the process in which a TBM breaks through the final wall after completing the tunnel excavation process. Tunnel boring operations […]...
